look_here_first: Think tiny yellow-to-purple Dalea: a very low perennial with silky compound leaves and ovoid flower spikes whose yellow flowers age rose-purple.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: very low perennial from taproot and slightly woody base

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: dense ovoid to oblong flower spikes

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: flowers yellow when fresh, aging rose to blue-purple

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: dry bare limestone, caliche, sandy or stony soils

lookalikes.differences: D. nana is the low yellow-then-purple member of the set. D. multiflora has white rounded heads; D. tenuis has pink-purple globes and extremely narrow, feathery linear leaflets.
